title: Architecture contribution header
description: The fenced yaml block at the top of architecture/contributions/<concern>.md. Uses only the JSON Schema subset validate_doc.py implements.

concern.description: The concern this file covers; it is also the file name without .md.

owner.description: The person who investigates the concern and merges its conclusion into hla.md.

status.description: draft while written, proposed once the owner offers it to the team, merged once the conclusion is in hla.md.

touches.description: Titles of the hla.md sections this contribution changes.

affects.description: Other concerns or component names this contribution has consequences for; may be empty.
